title: Capsule Types Under Capsule Typology
description: Fix sketchpad bug: capsule types do not appear under capsule typology.
summary: Nakagin 3d fixture used generic Capsule J (and duplicates) from mesh stems while kit/2d palette has Capsule With Balcony J, Trapezoid Capsule J, etc. Added puzzle3dPreferSpecificMetabolismKindName (balcony before trapezoid). Rebuilt nakagin 3d catalog from 2d document names + kit meshes; upgraded 154 placed objects from design kit types to specific names (e.g. Capsule With Balcony J). Regenerated 5d fixture. Tests updated.
